⛔ **Correction to this card's body — the mechanism it gave for "promotion is not a pure widening" was FALSE.**

`domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `session_012W3vMLTFY9SPr2LyxhSeYi`, 2026-09-09. Filed by the same seat that filed the card, on the ceiling re-review's finding at objectui#8499 comment `5597738741`. The body has been edited in place; this comment records what changed and why, so the edit is visible in the timeline rather than silent.

## What was wrong

The card said: curating one of the seven into `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` would make `react-page.tsx` **drop that tag from the `kind:'react'` JSX scope**, so a `main` an author writes in a react page today "would stop resolving".

It does not. Re-measured on `main` rather than taken on the review's word:

| leg | reading |
|---|---|
| `react-page.tsx:75-77` | `if (!tag \|\| cfg.isContainer) continue;` — skips **every** container config, whichever list it came from |
| `getMeta('main').isContainer` / `getConfig('main').isContainer` | `true` / `true` — the seven have carried the flag since objectui#6764 |
| injected identifiers today | **46** |
| injected identifiers with `main` promoted (simulated: push `main` onto `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, re-run the scope loop) | **46** |
| `Main` in either set | **absent from both**; set difference `[]` |
| the promoted config's own flag | `{"type":"main","isContainer":true}` — skipped on the same line an unlisted tag never reaches |
| `ComponentRegistry` references in `packages/react-runtime/src` | **0** (control: 21 `React` references in the same file; its only imports are `react` and `sucrase`) |

⇒ a lowercase `main` in a react page is a **DOM intrinsic before and after**. There was never an injected identifier for the flag to remove, and promotion does not create one.

## Where the error came from

The `semantic.tsx` docblock the card quotes is **accurate** — and the quote stays in the body. It describes objectui#6764's direction: declaring containment on a block that is **already public** removes an injected identifier *that existed*. Reading it forwards, as a statement about promotion, inverts it. That is the whole defect, and it is worth naming precisely because the quote itself is true.

## What actually changes on promotion

1. It **widens the AI-authoring vocabulary**, `sdui.manifest.json` and the generated intrinsics — a permanent public-contract surface.
2. It turns `container-declaration-census.test.tsx`'s *"none of the eight is in the curated public contract"* pin **red by design** — which is precisely what `semantic.tsx` means by *"re-opens the question HERE"*. Whoever promotes moves that pin deliberately.

⛔ What it does not cost is any react page.

## What does NOT change

⭐ **The decision this card asks for stands exactly as filed**, and so does the framing: promotion is **not** a roster edit. Both options remain open and neither is weakened — option 1 simply carries a different (and smaller) consequence than the body first claimed, and needs ⛔ no `react-page.tsx` change. This card stays **open**; nothing here decides it.

The same correction has been applied to the three other places the false mechanism was published: the shipped ledger string `SECTIONING_TAG_UNRULED` and the `UNCURATED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS` docblock in `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts`, and the body of PR #8763 (commit `005409fc1`).

**Triage: `domain:spec` · `pm:blocked` on objectui#8628 — ⛔ NOT a second decision card. Same family, one ruling.**

This card and objectui#8628 are the same question at different scale: members of the derived container population (`LayoutSchema.options` ∩ `ComponentRegistry meta isContainer === true`) that the curated vocabulary has **never ruled on, either way**. #8628 is `aspect-ratio` (one member); this is the seven semantic sectioning tags. The card says so itself — *"the same shape as objectui#8628, one family later"*.

SKILL.md: 同族近似单默认不进决策箱 —— 新支复用母单裁决直接入队. ⇒ **one decision goes to the maintainer, not two.** objectui#8628 carries it with the four-facet analysis; this card takes the same answer and applies it to the seven.

`Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#8628`, appended as a machine-readable body line so the unlock scan sees it without reading comments.

⚠️ **The inheritance is of the ruling *together with its reasoning*.** If #8628's answer turns on something specific to `aspect-ratio` (that it is one tag, or that it declares four real inputs), it does **not** automatically transfer to seven semantic sectioning tags — that is the named exception (母单理由被实测为分支特有时本条不适用). ⇒ when #8628 is answered, re-read the reasoning before applying it here; if it does not transfer, this card comes back to the decision box on its own merits. ⛔ Do not apply the letter of the answer against its reasoning.

⭐ Whatever the answer, the same requirement holds as on #8628: **it must leave a record**. "Excluded on merits" and "forgotten" read identically from outside, and that ambiguity is what produced both cards.
